summary: Iter318 Letters & Follow-ups overhaul: performed thorough code review of /app/backend/routes/care_plans.py (_resolve_situation + _compose_letter_intake + _SOURCE_TOOL_TO_LF1 + _SOURCE_LEADIN), /app/frontend/src/pages/tools/LettersFollowUps.jsx (front door with groups + blank-letter panel), and /app/frontend/src/pages/tools/CorrespondenceLog.jsx (mailbox with search/filters/delete). Frontend Playwright not attempted for same reason. All static/code checks pass.

critical.issue: Password login for cathy@example.com hangs >60s on localhost and preview URL, blocking automated backend testing. Other /api/* endpoints respond in <10ms. Likely bcrypt/HIBP work_factor or rate-limit lock. Login worked in prior iterations, so appears to be transient or a lockout from repeated attempts.

action_items: Investigate /api/auth/login latency in preview env (>60s). Check bcrypt rounds, HIBP check, user_login_lockout state for cathy@example.com — the account may be locked from prior failed attempts (USER_LOGIN_LOCKOUT_THRESHOLD=5, USER_LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES=15 in backend/.env). Consider a mongo unlock: db.users.updateOne({email:'cathy@example.com'},{$set:{login_failed_count:0,locked_until:null}}).
Once login is unblocked, re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter318_letters_overhaul.py to confirm the four assertions.
Main agent should self-verify the four flows via the running browser session (which per backend logs is actively hitting /api/lf1/* successfully).
